nodes.label: jsonb -> vs ->>
nodes.rationale: -> returns jsonb and chains; ->> returns text and terminates. One character decides type.
nodes.community_name: Postgres phase 12 beyond tables containment and jsonpat

nodes.label: Missing key vs JSON null
nodes.rationale: ->> returns SQL NULL for both a missing key and JSON null; use ? or jsonb_typeof to tell them apart.
nodes.community_name: Postgres phase 12 beyond tables containment and jsonpat

nodes.label: jsonb containment @>
nodes.rationale: Asks whether the document contains a fragment; GIN can serve it. ->> equality cannot.
nodes.community_name: Postgres phase 12 beyond tables containment and jsonpat

nodes.label: jsonpath @? and @@
nodes.rationale: Comparisons and wildcards that @> cannot express; GIN can serve both opclasses.
nodes.community_name: Postgres phase 12 beyond tables containment and jsonpat

nodes.label: jsonb expression index
nodes.rationale: Index (doc->>'tag') for a hot key: 0.9 ms and 1352 kB. Expression must match the query exactly, including casts.
nodes.community_name: Postgres phase 12 beyond tables containment and jsonpat

nodes.label: GIN jsonb_ops
nodes.rationale: Default GIN: indexes keys and values separately. Serves @> and ?; 17 MB here; cannot serve ->>.
nodes.community_name: Postgres phase 12 beyond tables containment and jsonpat

nodes.label: GIN jsonb_path_ops
nodes.rationale: One hash per path-plus-value. Smaller/faster for @> (1.1 ms, 13 MB) but cannot serve ?.
nodes.community_name: Postgres phase 12 beyond tables containment and jsonpat

nodes.label: tsvector lexemes
nodes.rationale: Sorted set of lexemes with positions. english stems and drops stop words; simple does neither.
nodes.community_name: Postgres phase 12 beyond tables containment and jsonpat

nodes.label: websearch_to_tsquery
nodes.rationale: Search-engine syntax; never raises. to_tsquery parses tsquery language and raises 42601 on ordinary user text.
nodes.community_name: Postgres phase 12 beyond tables containment and jsonpat

nodes.label: Generated tsvector column
nodes.rationale: Same speed as an expression index (~17 ms). Chosen to merge columns, carry setweight, and keep queries as tsv @@ q.
nodes.community_name: Postgres phase 12 beyond tables containment and jsonpat

nodes.label: to_tsvector IMMUTABLE config
nodes.rationale: One-arg to_tsvector(body) is rejected in an index (42P17) because it reads a session GUC. Name the config.
nodes.community_name: Postgres phase 12 beyond tables containment and jsonpat

nodes.label: ts_headline after LIMIT
nodes.rationale: Re-tokenises original text and cannot use the index. Apply after LIMIT so it runs for the page, not every match.
nodes.community_name: Postgres phase 12 beyond tables containment and jsonpat

nodes.label: gin_trgm_ops vs gist_trgm_ops
nodes.rationale: GIN for ILIKE/%/<%; GiST required for ORDER BY <-> nearest neighbour. GIN 9 MB vs GiST 22 MB here.
nodes.community_name: Postgres phase 12 beyond tables containment and jsonpat

nodes.label: pg_trgm % vs <%
nodes.rationale: % compares whole strings (0.273 on a long title). <% / word_similarity scores the best substring (1.000).
nodes.community_name: Postgres phase 12 beyond tables containment and jsonpat

nodes.community_name: Postgres phase 12 beyond tables containment and jsonpat

nodes.label: jsonb accessor vs predicate families
nodes.rationale: Accessors dig a value out; predicates ask a question. The family you pick decides whether an index can help.
nodes.community_name: Postgres phase 12 beyond tables containment and jsonpat

nodes.label: FTS and trigram are complements
nodes.rationale: FTS stems grammar but misses typos; trigram finds typos but cannot stem. Production: FTS first, trigram fallback.
nodes.community_name: Postgres phase 12 beyond tables containment and jsonpat

nodes.label: jsonb shallow merge ||
nodes.rationale: || replaces the whole top-level key; nested updates need jsonb_set. Every mutation rewrites the document.
nodes.community_name: Postgres phase 12 beyond tables column vs json

nodes.label: No foreign key into a jsonb key
nodes.rationale: CHECK on presence/range works; FOREIGN KEY from a jsonb key is 42601.
nodes.community_name: Postgres phase 12 beyond tables column vs json
nodes.norm_label: no foreign key into a jsonb key

nodes.label: jsonb key-name storage cost
nodes.rationale: Same two facts: 22 MB as jsonb vs 1736 kB as columns (~13x) because key names repeat per row.
nodes.community_name: Postgres phase 12 beyond tables column vs json

nodes.label: Hybrid columns plus jsonb
nodes.rationale: Promote queried keys to columns; keep the varying remainder as jsonb. Generated STORED columns migrate without a write-path change.
nodes.community_name: Postgres phase 12 beyond tables column vs json

nodes.label: jsonb_build_object allowlist
nodes.rationale: Explicit keys so a new column does not leak into the client payload, unlike to_jsonb(row).
nodes.community_name: Postgres phase 12 beyond tables build json sql

nodes.label: Shape JSON in JS not SQL
nodes.rationale: jsonb_agg 284.8 ms vs flat join + JS 90.7 ms; json_agg 131.2 ms. Use SQL constructors when the shape is the point.
nodes.community_name: Postgres phase 12 beyond tables build json sql
nodes.norm_label: shape json in js not sql

nodes.label: jsonb #> and #>> path operators
nodes.rationale: Path form takes text[]; prefer #>> when the path is fixed and deeper than two levels.
nodes.community_name: Postgres phase 12 beyond tables accessors and paths

nodes.label: jsonb_agg empty-collection trap
nodes.rationale: Need FILTER to drop the LEFT JOIN null row and coalesce to [] — either half alone ships null.
nodes.community_name: Postgres phase 12 beyond tables build json sql

nodes.label: tsquery prefix :*
nodes.rationale: Full-text matches whole lexemes; rout returns 0 rows, rout:* returns 13336. Type-ahead appends :*.
